prompts.foundry: Original exquisite old-school fantasy book illustration, expressive fine black ink contours and crosshatching, watercolor and gouache on textured aged paper. Sophisticated adult fantasy, muted verdigris, amber gold, midnight blue. No lettering, no logos, no interface, no borders, no 3D render, no pixel art. Landscape 3:2. A sprawling ancient mountain foundry at dusk, beautifully intricate brass waterwheels, glowing furnaces, mossy stone workshops, a clever suspended balancing mechanism, neatly stacked copper ingots and gear crates, a forge-lit bridge over a stream of water. A distant tiny cloaked traveler at the entrance. Warm copper light against teal mountain mist, fantastical craftsmanship and wonder, no danger or violence. Panoramic playable adventure location with a balancing platform on the left, gears at center, and a geometric workshop floor on right.
